newsitem.title: USA: Uno share buyback is over-subscribed.
newsitem.headline: Uno share buyback is over-subscribed.

text.p: Uno Restaurant Corp said Monday its one-million-share stock repurchase was over-subscribed when it expired Friday.
Under a preliminary count, more than 1.27 million shares were tendered, Uno said. The company had said it planned to repurchase one million shares at prices between $6 and $7.50 per share.
Uno said today it would pay $7.25 per share for the some one million shares tendered at or below that price.
The 1,029,659 shares tendered at or below $7.25 represent 7.5 percent of outstanding shares, it said.
All shares not purchased by the company, including those tendered at prices in excess of $7.25, will be returned to stockholders, it said.
